metadata.title: Steamed Fish | Home Recipe
metadata.description:
My father would buy tiny fish from the market, marinate them in a simple marinade of pounded chilies, ginger garlic paste, salt & oil and would cook them wrapped in banana leaves. We as kids would love the way he cooked those tiny fish. I am trying to recreate that part of my childhood through this dish but with a twist by using anchovies instead of fresh water fish caught from paddy fields.

Ingredients:

any small fish - 200 gms
green chilies - 8-10 or more
Ginger garlic paste - 1 tbsp
cooking oil - 1 tbsp
salt as required
